q1.question: When and where is the event?
q1.answer: The Estrella Dorada Awards gala will take place on September 24, 2026, from 19:00 to 22:00, at Fonda La Floresta (Cra. 6 #29, Armenia, Quindío).

q2.question: What is the dress code?
q2.answer: Formal gala attire with a mask (Formal - mask). The best mask will be awarded.

q3.question: Who can attend?
q3.answer: The event is for people over 18 years old. With prior VIP nominee tickets marked or sent via WhatsApp, they must be shown at the entrance.

q4.question: Is parking available?
q4.answer: Yes, parking is available in the Fonda La Floresta area.

q5.question: When is public voting?
q5.answer: Public voting takes place during the month of August 2026. Stay tuned to our official channels.

q6.question: Who do I contact if I have questions?
q6.answer: You can contact NATALIA at the email asobaresquindio@asobares.org or via WhatsApp +57 321 554 9513.

Mixologia.title: ORIGIN Mixology
Mixologia.subtitle: The Cocktail Route
Mixologia.description: We are looking for the best signature cocktail in Quindío! Asobares Quindío Chapter invites the best bars and gastrobars to submit their cocktail proposal in Mixology 360°. During the route, a panel of qualified judges will visit each establishment to evaluate technique, concept, service, and sensory balance. The official registration method will be published soon. Register your venue and compete for industry recognition.
